database_dir.description: Directory where index databases are stored.

document_dir.description: Directory where indexed HTML documents are stored (optional).

log_file.description: Path to the log file for indexing/search activity.

work_dir.description: Temporary directory used during indexing (cleaned automatically).

connection_timeout.description: Maximum time (seconds) to wait for an HTTP connection or response.

max_hops.description: Maximum depth (number of links) to crawl per starting URL.

max_documents.description: Upper limit on the total number of documents to index.

max_doc_size.description: Maximum document size (bytes) to index; larger files are skipped.

min_word_length.description: Shortest word length to include in the index.

max_word_length.description: Longest word length to include in the index.

case_insensitive.description: Whether searches ignore letter case (recommended for most sites).

stemming.description: Enable word stemming (e.g., 'running' → 'run') to improve recall.

fuzzy.description: Enable fuzzy matching for typo-tolerant searches.

synonyms.description: Enable synonym expansion (requires external synonym dictionary).

user_agent.description: HTTP User-Agent header to present when crawling.

result_template.description: Name of the result template to use (see `ResultTemplateFile`).

result_template_file.description: Path to the HTML template file for search results pages.

results_per_page.description: Number of results displayed per page in the web interface.

allowed_urls.description: List of regex patterns; only URLs matching these are indexed. Empty = allow all.

items.description: Regex pattern to match allowed URLs (e.g., '^https?://example\.com/').

disallowed_urls.description: List of regex patterns; URLs matching these are skipped.

excluded_extensions.description: File extensions (without dots) to exclude from indexing.

server_host.description: Hostname or IP address for the search server to bind to.

server_port.description: Port number for the search server (HTTP).

debug.description: Enable verbose debugging output (to log file).

verbose.description: Enable detailed progress messages during indexing.

fetchers.description: Number of concurrent HTTP fetchers (crawl workers).

fetch_delay.description: Minimum delay (seconds) between consecutive requests to the same host.

retry_count.description: Number of times to retry a failed HTTP fetch before skipping.

use_robots.description: Respect robots.txt and <meta name='robots'> directives during crawling.
